name: nametag-dev
description:
RQ1 model comparison, development data: GLiNER as shipped against NameTag 3 (Czech CNEC 2.0
and multilingual), each beside the rules, and GLiNER with each NameTag model as a union and
as agreement-only. NameTag 3 Czech was trained on CNEC 2.0 train and the multilingual model
on CNEC 2.0 and UNER Slovak-SNK train, so those two corpora favour it; REDACT and OpenPII are
the fairer comparisons.
